title: Mathematics IX–XII (DCAR 2024)
description: Four grade-level course maps aligned to the official Sindh Mathematics 2024 curriculum domains: Numbers & Algebra, Geometry, and Information & Handling. Includes lessons, practice MCQs, CRQs and ERQs per grade. Grade-level topic map; textbook chapter mapping remains to be verified.
curriculumAlignment: Sindh Curriculum for Mathematics Grade IX–XII 2024, based on National Curriculum of Pakistan 2023 minimum standards. Organized by grade and domain; not claiming exact STBB chapter order.

sourceReferences.title: Sindh Curriculum for Mathematics Grade IX–XII 2024

chapters.title: Grade IX: Mathematics
chapters.description: Grade-level sequence organized around the official DCAR curriculum domains: Numbers & Algebra, Geometry, and Information & Handling. Topics are a learning map, not a substitute for a verified textbook contents list.

lessons.title: Unit 1: Numbers, sets and algebra
lessons.content: Use real numbers, rational and irrational numbers, indices and algebraic expressions. Simplify expressions by applying laws of operations and explain each transformation. Show every algebraic step, state assumptions, check results and interpret answers in context.

explanations.ur: ریاضی میں ہر مرحلہ واضح لکھیں، مفروضے بیان کریں، جواب کی جانچ کریں اور نتیجے کو سوال کے تناظر میں سمجھیں۔
explanations.sd: رياضيءَ ۾ هر قدم واضح لکو، مفروضا بيان ڪريو، جواب جي جاچ ڪريو ۽ نتيجي کي سوال جي حوالي سان سمجهو۔

lessons.title: Unit 2: Equations, inequalities and functions
lessons.content: Solve linear equations and inequalities, represent solutions on number lines and interpret simple functions as rules mapping inputs to outputs. Show every algebraic step, state assumptions, check results and interpret answers in context.

explanations.ur: ریاضی میں ہر مرحلہ واضح لکھیں، مفروضے بیان کریں، جواب کی جانچ کریں اور نتیجے کو سوال کے تناظر میں سمجھیں۔

lessons.title: Unit 3: Geometry and data handling
lessons.content: Use angle properties, triangle and circle reasoning, measurement and geometric constructions. Collect, organize and interpret data using suitable tables and graphs. Show every algebraic step, state assumptions, check results and interpret answers in context.

writtenQuestions.modelAnswer: A valid solution identifies the known information, selects a relevant rule or formula, substitutes accurately, performs correct operations and checks whether the answer is reasonable.

lessons.content: Use polynomial operations, division and remainder ideas, and apply the binomial theorem to expand suitable expressions. Show every algebraic step, state assumptions, check results and interpret answers in context.

lessons.content: Interpret integration as antiderivative and accumulation, evaluate standard integrals and solve introductory first-order differential equations in suitable contexts. Show every algebraic step, state assumptions, check results and interpret answers in context.
